overview_description.description: Zomorod Ecommerce LLC is a leading e-commerce organization purposefully focused on online retailer of the concentrated niche market of health & beauty products and logistics. Zomorod operates in the Sultanate of Oman and currently delivers to its growing online retail market share in Oman, UAE, and KSA.   The company is built upon its robust value system to help more consumers by creating access to globally well-known brands and products.   Our purpose is to  Support businesses to launch their new brands around the MENA region through online possibilities with Zomorod. Protect consumers by providing transparency in the quality of products, pricing, and promotions to help them choose the best suitable product. Support the economy with world-class standards in technology and service. At Zomorod, with creative ideas, teamwork, and hard work, we create a unique and convenient online shopping experience.  At Zomorod our vision is to support more businesses, expand to more product lines, deliver to more areas, and make more friends out of our customers.
